title: Quantum Simulation of Stokes Flow via Schrödingerisation and Artificial Compressibility
summary: Simulating incompressible Stokes flow is essential for studies in microfluidics and low-Reynolds number hydrodynamics. However, the computational cost of resolving the associated saddle-point problem grows prohibitively with the dimensionality of the problem. In this work, we present a quantum algorithm based on the Schrödingerisation technique for the Stokes equations, incorporating an artificial compressibility regularization.
